store.name: Demo Tech Store
store.disclosure: This is a course-project demo. No real orders, payments, refunds, accounts, shipping, or human-agent connections are performed.

shipping.text: Under the simulated store policy, standard delivery is estimated at 3–5 business days after dispatch. Express delivery, where offered, is estimated at 1–2 business days. A real checkout would show methods, costs, and a final estimate; this demo has no checkout or live carrier quotes.

address_change.text: A delivery address change can be requested before dispatch. After dispatch, the customer must contact support; a change is not guaranteed. The chatbot cannot modify an order.

cancellation.text: A cancellation can be requested before dispatch with no demo cancellation fee. Once dispatched, cancellation is unavailable; the customer may review the return and refund policy. The chatbot cannot cancel an order.

refund.text: In this simulated store, an unused accessory in its original packaging may be submitted for refund review within 14 calendar days of delivery. Defective devices are assessed through the product warranty or support process. Approval is required; the chatbot cannot approve or issue a refund. After approval, a demo refund would be sent to the original payment method in an estimated 5-10 business days.

warranty_and_repair.text: Warranty coverage depends on the product and purchase terms. The demo bot can explain how to request service, but it must not give step-by-step instructions for opening, repairing, or replacing internal hardware such as a laptop screen. Customers should use qualified or authorized service.

account_and_privacy.text: In a real store, account changes use authenticated account settings or support. This demo has no customer account operations, and the chatbot cannot view or change a real account. Never ask for a password, one-time code, or full payment-card number in chat.

invoice.text: In a real store, a customer would view an invoice summary and download a copy from the order page. This demo has no order history or actual invoices; the bot cannot retrieve or verify a real invoice.

payment.text: A real checkout lists available payment methods; this demo does not process payments. If a real charge appears after checkout fails, avoid retrying until checking the payment record and contact the seller through a verified channel with a non-sensitive reference. The bot cannot verify or reverse a charge.

contact.text: The demo has no live agent. A request to contact a person can be recorded as a handoff intent, but no real contact is made. Do not invent phone numbers, email addresses, or support hours.

clarify.response: Could you tell me whether you need help with an order, delivery, payment, refund, invoice, or account? Please do not share a password or full card number.

handoff.response: I understand that you would like a person to help. This course demo has no live agent connection; please use the store's official support channel in a real purchase.

scope_boundary.response: I can help with this demo technology store's orders, delivery, payments, refunds, invoices, and accounts. I cannot help with that request.

hardware_repair_boundary.response: I cannot guide a do-it-yourself laptop screen repair. For safety and warranty reasons, please use qualified or authorized service. I can explain the demo warranty support route.

intent_responses.response: In this demo, cancellation before dispatch has no fee. A real cancellation would need to be requested through the store’s order page or support team; I can’t cancel an order here.

For a real order, request an address change before dispatch through support. Changes after dispatch may not be possible; I can’t update an address here.

To view an invoice, a real store would show its summary on the order page. This demo has no actual invoices for me to open or verify.
A real checkout shows which payment methods are available. This demo does not take payments; please don’t share card details in chat.

For a real purchase, check the seller’s order page or tracking link for its latest status. This demo cannot look up a live order or shipment.
